output.reason: [ev-d55f4ac0a53f] shows that from 0.15.0 to 0.16.0 the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io CRD's spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage changed from true to false. So the v1beta1 ClusterSecretStore GVK is still served but is no longer the storage version. A validator confirmed the subject, and behavior-changed is the right change type for it. The before/after values in the diff are the YAML booleans true → false, not the strings "true"/"false", so I corrected the literals.

correction.statement: In 0.16.0, external-secrets.io/v1beta1 ClusterSecretStore stops being the storage version of the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io CRD (spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage: true → false); v1 becomes the storage version, and existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten.
